arguments.question: What is the Pharos Pacific mainnet chain ID and RPC URL?
arguments.goal: Help a developer build on Pharos. Answer in at most 180 words before sources. If the docs do not answer the question, say no relevant information found. Cite the specific documentation sections. Do not invent facts.

content.text:
Pharos Pacific Mainnet uses **chain ID `1672`** and RPC URL [`https://rpc.pharos.xyz`](https://rpc.pharos.xyz).

Source: [Pacific Mainnet](/getting-started/network/pacific-mainnet).
